description: This Swift source file extends the CronSettings class to define its SwiftUI view layout, including various UI components such as headers, content, dialogs, alerts, and banners related to managing cron jobs in an application.

methods.name: schedulerBanner
methods.description: Constructs a SwiftUI view that displays a banner if the cron scheduler is disabled, providing a warning message and optional scheduler store path.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Constructs the header section of the view, including the title 'Cron' and buttons for refreshing jobs and creating new jobs.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Creates the main content area with a list of cron jobs, error/status messages, and a detail view of selected jobs.

methods.name: detail
methods.description: Builds the detailed view for the selected cron job, including headers, information, and run history.
